hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','') or '')" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in */config/local.env|*/config/prod.env|config/local.env|config/prod.env) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"config/local.env and config/prod.env hold real secrets (Qdrant/DB credentials) and are gitignored - edit them manually, not via an agent tool call."}}' ;; esac
hooks.statusMessage: Checking for edits to secret config files...

hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','') or '')" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.py) .venv/bin/ruff check --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; .venv/bin/ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac; exit 0
